question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: Electric charge is a scalar quantity.
Electric charge is a vector quantity.

solution:
Correct Answer **__Electric charge is a vector quantity__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Properties of electric charge 

__
 
• The electric charge on an object is not affected by the motion of that object, unlike mass. 
 
• **Electric charge **is additive in nature as the algebraic sum of charges located at various points on an object gives the** total charge on the object.**
 
• The** charge of a system **is always conserved that is, the charge **can neither be created nor destroyed.**
 
• The total charge on an object is said to be ***n e* **where **n** is an integer. Thus, showing charge is **quantized.**
 
• The** magnitude of both positive** and **negative charge** is **1.6 × 10-19 C.**
 
• Also, unlike charges attract each other, and like charges repel each other.

Explanation:__

**Electric charge** is invariant; it does not change with a **change in velocity.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ **

__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• The smallest unit of an element that has all the chemical properties of the element is called as an atom.
 
• Atoms are made of the three smallest particles- electrons, protons, and neutrons.
 
• The protons and neutrons remain in the nucleus of the atom and electrons revolve around the nucleus.
 
• The electrons are negatively charged, protons are positively charged and neutrons are neutral.

EXPLANATION__:

 
• The atoms of an element are neutral in nature because it contains an equal number of electrons and protons.
 
• If some of the free electrons are removed from the atom then the number of protons increases with respect to the number of electrons and the atom becomes positively charged.
 
• If some of the electrons are added to the atoms then the number of protons decreases with respect to the number of electrons and the atoms become negatively charged.
 
• The number of protons is always equal to atomic number of the atoms.
